title: Days out from the Victorian election, nine datacentre projects await approval. What will their fate be?
summary_full: While parties have come out with policies on where datacentres can be built, not all are clear on whether they apply retrospectivelyGet our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastDays out from the Victorian state election, the fate of nine datacentre projects remains uncertain, with some companies confident they will be able to get their projects across the line after Saturday.There are nine datacentre projects currently awaiting approval according to the ministerial permits register, including the West Footscray expansion of NextDC’s M3 datacentre, which Guardian Australia reported has faced delays due to community blowback.
